property_summary: After calling Deposit with value v, the contract's total ETH balance increases only when v is at least MinDeposit.
After calling Deposit with value v, the contract's ETH balance increases iff v >= c.MinDeposit().
If the contract C's ETH balance increases after calling Deposit with value v, then v must be at least c.MinDeposit().
After calling Deposit with value v, the contract's ETH balance increases if and only if v >= c.MinDeposit().

For any caller and amount, if the caller's balance is >= amount then after CashOut(amount) the caller's balance decreases by exactly amount (balances[msg.sender] == old - amount); the mutant inverts Deposit's guard so some deposits never increased balances, causing CashOut to potentially succeed with different balances at other keys and violate this conserved-balance behavior for some inputs.

Invariant: after any CashOut call, the total sum of all stored balances in the reference C is equal to the contract's recorded balances sum before minus the withdrawn amount (i.e., CashOut only moves value out of the caller's balance when that balance was actually previously increased by accepted deposits); the mutant can accept only msg.value < MinDeposit, so some deposits that should have been recorded are not, causing the mapping aggregate to differ after CashOut for some fuzzed inputs and addresses.
